text:
```artifact
Decision Table for Battery Alarm Logic

Conditions:
1. Battery Presence (Present / Absent)
2. Chargeability (Chargeable / Unchargeable)
3. Battery Remaining Amount History (Low / Normal)
4. Computed Battery ETA ( <10min / 10-30min / >30min )

Actions:
- Display Low Battery Alarm (Low Priority)
- Display Critically Low Battery Alarm (High Priority)
- Display Battery Failure Alarm
- Compute and Display Battery ETA

| Battery Presence | Chargeability | Remaining Amount History | Computed ETA (min) | Low Battery Alarm | Critically Low Battery Alarm | Battery Failure Alarm |
|------------------|---------------|--------------------------|---------------------|-------------------|-----------------------------|-----------------------|
| Present          | Chargeable    | Low                      | 5                   | Yes (Low)         | Yes (High)                 | No                    |
| Present          | Chargeable    | Normal                   | 15                  | No                | No                          | No                    |
| Present          | Chargeable    | Normal                   | 10                  | Yes (Low)         | Yes (High)                 | No                    |
| Present          | Chargeable    | Normal                   | 30                  | Yes (Low)         | No                          | No                    |
| Present          | Chargeable    | Normal                   | 35                  | No                | No                          | No                    |
| Present          | Unchargeable  | Any                      | Any                 | No                | No                          | Yes                   |
| Absent           | Any           | Any                      | Any                 | No                | No                          | Yes                   |

```
